report: Nineteen human proofs reconstruct the original curve, finite-generation and coefficient-extension consumers. The packet proves the all-field local flag, the integral near-identity flag, every local-domain ordinary specialization, the actual integral entry grading, characteristic-prime DVR detection, full FinCrit and full ConstOfChar. An elementary trace Gram argument preserves characteristic3 without a Brauer--Nesbitt input. From the stated FinEnd it proves literal FinA. From stated FinA it identifies the complete weight-zero algebra with the original entry algebra component, strictly rescales every arbitrary algebraic entry map, and extends it into a finite coefficient DVR. It proves irreducibility on every open subgroup and returns both rank-three and rank-two automorphic conclusions along exact torus conjugacy. UCE19 is the complete same-g1 GdEnd implication. GdEnd and its upstream actual frame, seeds, general PfromAut/ModUAlt and descent remain explicit. No selected obligation is proposed for closure by this packet alone.
